Commentary.Commentary: That is it from the ODI series. Pakistan have managed to win the 50-over format by 2-1. The action now moves to the shortest format. Pakistan will look to win that as well while South Africa will be eager to avenge for the ODI series loss. The 4-match T20I series starts on Saturday, 10th April. The first T20I begins at 1430 local (1230 GMT). Make sure you join us for that. Till then, goodbye and take care!

For his blistering 94, Pakistan skipper, Babar Azam is also named the Player of the Match. Babar says that it was fun today especially after the start the openers gave them. Tells they gave him the momentum to play well. Babar says that when they lost wickets, he was just telling the new batters that if they get partnership it will be better. Credits Hasan Ali for playing the knock he played. Babar says he was surprised to play spin but tells when he saw the wicket he knew that spinner would be used more and they were prepared for it. Credits the team for putting up a good total. Babar says it was a very important series as winning in South Africa has given them a lot of confidence and tells they are looking to carry this confidence into the T20I series.

For his brilliant performance with the bat throughout the series, Fakhar Zaman is named the Player of the Series. Fakhar says that his plan was simple. He was looking to play normally in the first 10 overs. Fakhar says that it is not easy to bat in the morning and the plan was to survive the first 10 overs. Fakhar says it means a lot as he had not scored for the past two years and it was important. Thanks the skipper for believing in him and backing him. Fakhar says he is happier to win the series.

South Africa skipper, Temba Bavuma, is not available so their coach Mark Boucher stands in for him. Boucher says that they are disappointed to lose the series at home. Credits Pakistan for the way they played. Tells they lost the game at the back end with the ball and feels not taking wickets early cost them. Boucher says they were setting small targets. Tells they tried to work hard and felt spin was the best option but admits they might have bowled one too many. Boucher says that they played well in certain stages of the game but adds when they have been bad they have been very bad and Pakistan have made them pay for it. Tells there are a lot of positives to take but right now there is a lot of disappointment. Boucher says there is no excuse. Tells there is a lot of work to be done and says it is never easy to lose and hopes they can get some special performance in T20Is. Boucher says Bavuma does not look good and tells they could see he was struggling. Adds he is not too sure about his near future regarding his injury.

Earlier in the evening, Pakistan were put to bat. They responded really well as once again their top 3 managed to get runs. Fakhar continued his form and scored another ton. Imam too played well for his 57. The foundation was laid but the middle order failed. Babar though stuck like a glue and a fiery finish by the Pakistan skipper and Hasan Ali managed to take the side to 320, a total that proved to be good enough to seal the series. Keshav Maharaj was the star with the ball for South Africa as he finished with a 3-fer.

A very good bowling display from Pakistan. They needed to ensure to keep getting wickets at regular intervals and that is what they did. They never let South Africa get ahead of the run rate while also putting brakes with regular wickets. Barring Faheem Ashraf all the other 5 bowlers got at least a wicket. Nawaz was the pick of the lot as he finished with 3-fer. Rauf delivered at crunch situations and finished with 2 wickets. Shaheen too managed to grab 3. Usman and Hasan Ali got one each but the latter was quite expensive. In the end the overall efforts of the bowlers was good enough to seal the series.

Chasing 321, South Africa got off to a decent start as the openers got off to a 50-run stand. But Markram failed to convert his start. JJ Smuts and Temba Bavuma also sailed the same boat. Janneman Malan played a very good hand of 70 but failed to convert it into a telling ton. At 140/5, all hope looked lost. Kyle Verryenne and Andile Phehlukwayo though kept the hosts in the game. The pair added 108-run with both getting their fifties. That though was not enough as both the batters departed in quick succession and all but sealed the game for Pakistan. Maharaj and Dupavillon played a small cameo but it was too little too late.

Pakistan have done the job and won the 3-match ODI series, 2-1. They have been on the receiving end of a lot of series in South Africa against them but they have found a way to get over the line and seal the series.

OUT! LBW! Klaasen departs and Pakistan are all over South Africa in this game. The last proper batsman is out now and we are into all-rounders and bowlers. Replay rolls in and Ball Tracker rolls in and it shows the pitching to be fine. Impact is good too. The wicket is hitting on umpire's call. It is just hitting the top of middle. South Africa retain the review but it is not good enough to keep Klaasen out in the middle. What a game Nawaz is having.  South Africa need another 181 runs in 135 balls.

JJ Smuts gets on his back foot and looks to defend. He leaves a gap between his bat and pad. The ball skids on and goes right through that gate to hit the stumps. South Africa need 244 in 212 balls.
Floated delivery on middle, Malan pushes it towards mid on for a quick single.
Short delivery on middle, Smuts pulls it through square leg for a run.
Tossed up delivery on middle, Malan flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
On off, Smuts defends it off the back foot.
FOUR! That is put away! Short delivery on middle, Smuts pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Full on off, Smuts pushes it to mid off.

Length ball on off, Smuts punches it through covers. The batsmen get two runs.
WIDE! Short delivery wide outside off, Smuts looks to slash but misses it.
Flighted ball on off, Malan drives it to covers.
On middle, Smuts flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Floated delivery on off, Smuts blocks it off the front foot.
The physio is out now to have a check at JJ Smuts' elbow.
Flighted ball on middle, Smuts looks to sweep but misses it and gets hit on the thigh pad. An appeal for lbw but the umpire shakes his head.

FOUR! Nicely swept! Tossed up delivery on middle, Smuts sweeps it through mid-wicket for a boundary.

Full delivery on middle, Smuts flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up delivery on off, Malan defends it to point.
Full toss again on middle, Smuts pushes it towards mid on for a run.
Full toss on middle, Malan flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy delivery on leg, Malan looks to flick but misses it and gets hit on the pads. An appeal for lbw but the umpire shakes his head.
Floated ball on off, Malan defends it back towards the bowler.
Tossed up delivery on middle, Smuts flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Powerplay 2 time! Now additional 2 fielders can be placed outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over. Debutant, Usman Qadir will bowl his first over in ODIs as he will inaugurate PP2!
PLAY AND A MISS! Excellent bowling by Haris Rauf! Good length delivery outside off, Malan looks to drive but misses it. SOUTH AFRICA ARE 54/1 AT THE END OF POWERPLAY 1!
BEATEN AGAIN! Full ball outside off, Malan looks to drive but misses it.
BEATEN! Good length delivery outside off, Malan looks to drive but misses it.

Full on middle, Malan flicks it to mid-wicket.
JJ Smuts walks out at number 3! Also, Haris Rauf to bowl the final over of Powerplay 1!

OUT! CAUGHT! Shaheen Afridi gets the breakthrough Pakistan needed. Once again Markram gets the start, looks good but fails to make it count. A big wicket for Pakistan as the Proteas openers were going all guns blazing. Good length ball pitching outside off and coming back in. Markram looks to punch but the ball comes back in and goes between his pad and bat, taking a deflection. It goes straight into the mitts of Sarfaraz Ahmed. There is an appeal but the umpire is unmoved. The Pakistan player form a small hurdle. Imam thinks there is a definite edge and he convinces Babar to signal the 'T'. Babar does so at the eleventh hour. Replay rolls in and Ultra Edge shows a spike as the ball goes past the bat before kissing the pad. Jubilation for Pakistan and the solid opening stand comes to an end.
Review time! It is for a caught behind against Markram. Let's see what the replays have to say.
Full delivery on off, Malan drives it towards covers for a single.
FOUR! Length delivery on leg, Malan flicks it towards fine leg for a boundary.
NO BALL! Length delivery on off, Malan punches it to covers. The third umpire calls it a no ball as Afridi oversteps!
FOUR! That is smashed! Short delivery outside off, Malan pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Length delivery on off, Malan looks to go big but gets an inside edge on it.
Short delivery on off, Malan punches it to point.
On the pads, Malan flicks it to the on side and keeps the strike.
FOUR! Supreme from Malan! Fuller on middle, Malan maintains his shape and times it to perfection through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Length delivery on off, it is a slower ball. Markram plays it behind point for one.
Length ball on off, Markram pushes it to mid off.

NOT OUT! Good length delivery on off, Malan pushes it towards mid off and goes for the single. The fielder fires a direct hit at the bowler's end. It is referred upstairs. Replays show that Malan's dive saved him.
FOUR! Good shot! Full on off, Malan lofts it over mid off for a boundary.

Length delivery on middle, Malan pushes it to mid on.
Full on off, Malan pushes it to mid off.
On off, Malan punches it to cover and keeps the strike with a single. Solid start or South Africa. They are 27/0 at the halfway stage of Powerplay 1!

FOUR! Crunched away! This is top class shot from Malan! Not a bad ball at all from Shaheen. Bowls a back of a length delivery around off. Malan gets on his front, gets on top of the bounce and slams it through cover-point for a boundary.
Length ball on middle, Malan once again finds the middle of the bat as he finds cover this time.
FOUR! That is slammed! Slightly behind the length area outside off. Malan gets on his back foot and punches it through point for a boundary. Classy from Janneman Malan!
Good length ball on middle, Markram punches it to cover.
Good length delivery around off, Malan plays it to point.
Hasan Ali hits the deck hard on middle. Markram defends it towards mid on.
Length delivery on off, Markram drives it but finds cover.
Length ball on middle, Markram plays it to mid on.
Outside off, Markram leaves it alone. Shows good composure there.

SIX! BOOM! First biggie of the inning! Short but not short enough to trouble Markram. He picks up the length and pulls it over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie. It hits the cameraman who was lying on the grass.
FOUR! Magnificent! This is going straight into the highlight reel! Full outside off, Markram leans forward and gets on top of the bounce to play a glorious cover drive for a boundary.
Another slash and a miss! Length ball wide outside off, Malan swings but to no avail.
Outside off, Malan punches it to cover.
Slightly short and close to the body. Malan pulls it through square leg for a brace.
Shaheen hits the deck hard around off, Malan keeps it out.
Length ball on middle, Malan defends it.
Swing and miss! Good length delivery outside off, Malan looks to punch it through the off side but the ball goes away with the angle and beats him.

FOUR! Lovely shot! First boundary of the innings and it comes off the majestic bat of Aiden Markram! Length ball on middle and leg, Markram times it and powers it through mid-wicket for a boundary to finish the over.
Excellent shot but straight to the fielder. Good length delivery outside off, Markram crunches his punch but straight to short cover.
Good length delivery on off, Markram keeps it out.
Length ball on off, Markram pushes it to mid off.
Appeal for LBW but turned down. On the pads, Markram looks to flick but misses and gets hit on his thigh pad. An appeal follows but the umpire is unmoved. Looked too high.
Hasan's first ball does not bounce! Good length delivery outside off, there is a puff of dust from the deck. It keeps low and goes under Markram's bat.
Hasan Ali to bowl from the other end.
Markram is off the mark as well! On the pads, Markram flicks it to fine leg and keeps the strike.
Good length ball on off, Markram punches it to cover.
Length ball outside off, Markram taps it off his back foot back to the bowler.
Malan is off the mark! Extra bounce for Shaheen as he hits the deck hard on off. Malan plays it to third man and gets a single to get the first run of South Africa's innings.
Play and a miss! Good start from Shaheen. Good length delivery pitching on off and going away with the angle. Malan looks to punch but misses.
Hint of late inswing for Shaheen first up. Good length ball outside off, the swing comes in once the ball goes past the stumps. Malan leaves it alone.
